text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Today presents a new opportunity to<n>put my
winning equation to the test.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Imperfect though it may yet be, I willcomplete it and use it to beat everysingle opponent I face.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
And even if the probability of winning<n>is a mere one
percent, I still intend to<n>beat them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I take it you're on my side?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Folks, it's time for the Kikuka Sho, the<n>final race of
the Classic Triple Crown!<n>Biwa Hayahide has made
her way to<n>the paddock now...

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text:
Hm? So that's Biwa Hayahide? She<n>looks to be in
fantastic shape. Just<n>what kind of training did she
do to<n>achieve such a powerful physique?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmph. You'd better believe I've been<n>training hard.
I'm here to win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My winning equation is just what it<n>sounds like—a
formula for victory!
